items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: So the next day I called Charlie Barnet and I said, "Well, I can't come, but I've got a good man for you."

ctx.x: He looked like a mole, anyhow, so I didn't want to talk to him. I talked to Cab. So then I let it go. So then I told Diz, "Well, when we get back to New York I'll call Charlie," and I said, "Maybe he can give you that job, you know." So the next day I called Charlie Barnet and I said, "Well, I can't come, but I've got a good man for you." He said, "Who?" And I says, "His name is Dizzy Gillespie." He wasn't too known then. But he said -- right away he said, "That's that guy that cut Cab, ain't it?" He said, "Hell,…
Well, what did happen to Diz? Where did he go?
